children: The Contracts Cover a Dedicated Communication Satellite for the Indian Air Force and Heavy-Weight Torpedoes for the Indian Navy, Strengthening Secure Communication and Underwater Combat Capabilities
The Ministry of Defence has signed contracts worth a total of approximately Rs 4,106 crore for the acquisition of a dedicated communication satellite capability, GSAT-7C for the Indian Air Force, and
Heavy Weight Torpedoes for the Indian Navy, in New Delhi on 15 October 2026.

The contract for GSAT-7C, valued at Rs 2,563 crore, was inked with New Space India, Bengaluru. This indigenously designed, developed and manufactured satellite will enhance the secure, resilient and seamless communication capabilities for the assets of the Indian Air Force, thereby strengthening operational effectiveness.
was signed with Bharat Dynamics, Hyderabad worth Rs 1,543 crore.

is an indigenous ship-launched anti-submarine torpedo developed by the Naval Science and Technological Laboratory. Equipped with advanced maneuvering capabilities, it is capable of engaging enemy submarines at long ranges, thereby enhancing the anti-submarine warfare capability of the Indian Navy.

The contracts were signed in the presence of A Anbarasu, Additional Secretary and Director General (Acquisition), Department of Defence .
